description: Reference lexicon of common Hindi and Hinglish expressions of distress and medication side effects. Each candidate meaning includes a clinical term (for clinician view only), a plain-language English meaning (meaningEn), a plain-language Hindi meaning (meaningHi), and status='unvalidated'.

candidateMeanings.meaning: Psychological anxiety, panic, or sudden sense of fear/dread
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Feeling anxious, panicky, or a sudden sense of fear
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: मन में अचानक डर, चिंता या घबराहट महसूस होना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Physical restlessness or inner agitation (possible akathisia)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Physical restlessness or feeling unable to sit still
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: शरीर में बेचैनी होना या एक जगह शांति से बैठ न पाना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Autonomic symptoms such as racing heart (palpitations) or chest tightness
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Fast heartbeat or tightness in the chest
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: दिल की धड़कन तेज़ होना या सीने में जकड़न महसूस होना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Difficulty falling asleep at night (initial insomnia)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Difficulty falling asleep when going to bed at night
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: रात में सोने की कोशिश करने पर देर तक नींद न आना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Fragmented sleep with frequent nighttime awakenings (maintenance insomnia)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Waking up repeatedly during the night
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: रात में बार-बार नींद खुल जाना और ठीक से सो न पाना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Awareness of fast or pounding heartbeat (palpitations)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Feeling your heart beating fast or pounding
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: दिल की धड़कन तेज़ या ज़ोर-ज़ोर से चलते हुए महसूस होना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Sudden emotional dread, sinking feeling, or acute anxiety
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: A sudden sinking feeling, worry, or strong anxiety
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: अचानक मन बैठने लगना, डर लगना या बहुत चिंता होना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Epigastric uneasiness or nausea-like sensation in the upper stomach/chest
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Uneasiness or nausea-like feeling in the upper stomach or chest
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: ऊपरी पेट या सीने में अजीब-सी उलझन या जी मिचलाने जैसा लगना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Tension-type headache or physical pressure in the head
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Headache or a feeling of physical pressure in the head
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: सिर में दर्द या दबाव और भारीपन महसूस होना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Daytime sedation, grogginess, or cognitive fog from the medication
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Feeling sleepy, groggy, or foggy during the day from the medicine
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: दवाई की वजह से दिन में नींद या सुस्ती और सिर सुन्न-सा लगना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Orthostatic lightheadedness or dizziness
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Feeling lightheaded or dizzy, especially when standing up
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: सिर हल्का लगना या उठते समय चक्कर जैसा महसूस होना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Motor restlessness or inability to sit still (possible akathisia)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Physical restlessness in the body or inability to sit still
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: शरीर में ऐसी छटपटाहट या बेचैनी होना कि एक जगह बैठना मुश्किल लगे

candidateMeanings.meaning: Psychological worry, inner tension, or emotional unease
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Inner worry, mental tension, or feeling uneasy inside
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: मन के अंदर चिंता, उलझन या अशांति महसूस होना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Depressed mood or persistent sadness
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Feeling low or persistently sad
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: मन उदास रहना या लगातार दुखी महसूस करना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Anhedonia (loss of interest/pleasure) or medication-induced emotional blunting
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Loss of interest in daily activities or feeling emotionally flat
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: किसी काम में मन न लगना या भावनाएं सुन्न-सी लगना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Lightheadedness or feeling faint upon standing (orthostatic dizziness)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Feeling lightheaded or faint when standing up
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: खड़े होने या उठने पर आँखों के आगे अँधेरा छाना या बेहोशी जैसा लगना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Spinning sensation (true vertigo) or vestibular imbalance
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Feeling like the room is spinning or losing balance
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: आस-पास की चीज़ें घूमती हुई लगना या शरीर का संतुलन बिगड़ना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Hand tremor (involuntary shaking of the hands)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Shaking of the hands that you cannot control
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: अपने-आप हाथ काँपना या कोई चीज़ पकड़ते समय हाथ हिलना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Dry mouth (xerostomia / anticholinergic side effect)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Dryness in the mouth or throat
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: बार-बार मुँह या गला सूखना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Daytime drowsiness or sedation (feeling sleepy from the medication)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Feeling sleepy or drowsy during the day from the medicine
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: दवाई की वजह से दिन में बहुत नींद या सुस्ती आना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Physical fatigue, lethargy, or bodily weakness without sleepiness
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Physical tiredness or lack of energy in the body without feeling sleepy
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: नींद आए बिना शरीर में थकान, कमज़ोरी या ताकत की कमी लगना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Emotional blunting (feeling emotionally numb or flat)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Feeling emotionally numb or unable to feel normal emotions
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: मन की भावनाएं सुन्न हो जाना (न खुशी महसूस होना, न दुख)

candidateMeanings.meaning: Cognitive slowing or difficulty concentrating (brain fog)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Difficulty thinking clearly or concentrating
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: सोचने-समझने या ध्यान लगाने में कठिनाई और सुस्ती लगना

candidateMeanings.meaning: Upper gastrointestinal distress (nausea, queasiness, or dyspepsia)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Stomach discomfort, indigestion, or feeling like throwing up
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: पेट में अपच, जलन या जी मिचलाना (उल्टी जैसा लगना)

candidateMeanings.meaning: Bowel disturbance (diarrhea / loose stools or constipation)
candidateMeanings.meaningEn: Loose motions (diarrhea) or constipation
candidateMeanings.meaningHi: दस्त लगना (पेट खराब होना) या कब्ज़ की परेशानी होना
